item.title: Walking the canals Instead of dining out: tourists spending less in Amsterdam
item.description: Tourists are spending less and less money in Amsterdam.

item.title: Thousands left without water in Drachten after main pipeline break; Issue now resolved
item.description: Thousands of residents in Drachten experienced a water outage after a main pipe on Noorderhogeweg broke, according to Fryslân Veilig.

item.title: Icy conditions in tunnels causing road closures and lane reductions
item.description: Slippery road conditions have occurred on multiple roads in the Netherlands, particularly in and near tunnels, where leaking water has frozen.

item.title: Heemskerk minor in custody after major fireworks seizure
item.description: A minor in Heemskerk was arrested earlier this week after authorities found heavy fireworks and drugs in his possession, according to the police report.

item.title: Dutch man arrested in Vienna after high-speed chase; Faces 12-year sentence in NL
item.description: Authorities in Vienna have detained a 23-year-old Dutch national who was the subject of a European arrest warrant.

item.title: Tilburg youths arrested for targeting emergency workers, police with fireworks
item.description: Youths in Tilburg targeted emergency responders and a parked police vehicle with fireworks on Wednesday evening, police reported on Friday.

item.title: Two killed in car accident on N242 in Zuid-Scharwoude
item.description: Two people lost their lives on Friday morning after an accident on the N242 in Zuid-Scharwoude.

item.title: Basketball coach convicted of secretly recording kids in locker room; No more jail time
item.description: The Noord-Holland District Court has sentenced a basketball coach to 180 hours of community service for filming boys in a changing room in Landsmeer.

item.title: Amsterdam Mayor Femke Halsema, actor Jeroen Krabbe to speak at Holocaust Remembrance
item.description: Actor Jeroen Krabbé and Amsterdam Mayor Femke Halsema will speak on Sunday, January 25, during the National Holocaust Remembrance Day, NOS reports.

item.title: Volt Amsterdam proposes floating student campus and youth reforms
item.description: Volt Amsterdam has unveiled a municipal election program aimed at improving life for young residents in the city.
